description: This is a shell script for platform-specific upgrade and check routines used in embedded router firmware management. It contains functions to verify image compatibility, perform firmware upgrades for various hardware models, and copy configuration data.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image to ensure it is compatible with the current board, providing specific instructions if a partition still exists that could interfere with the upgrade.

methods.name: askey_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade for Askey devices by extracting the root filesystem from the archive and writing it to the device.

methods.name: zyxel_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade for Zyxel devices by extracting kernel and root filesystem from the archive and writing to appropriate partitions.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_mikrotik_nand
methods.description: Handles firmware upgrade for Mikrotik devices with NAND flash, formatting and writing the kernel from the archive.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher that selects the appropriate upgrade method based on board name, supporting multiple device models.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data post-upgrade for certain devices.
